thread:
Ria: Quick decision sync: we need a minimal GA scope for console observability this quarter. Keep it tight — what is the absolute "ship" list?
Alex: Minimal: a compact cost card (last-7d + delta), CSV export, and per-route tagging. No deep drilldowns for GA.
Sam: Trace hooks: ship sampling toggle + API that records events. No scripting or complex transforms for GA. Smoke test that sampled requests produce traces.
Jordan: Ops constraints: define canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%) and guardrails: p95 latency, error rate, CPU. Rollback if p95 +7% sustained 10m or CPU >85%.
Maya: Customers want customer_id in export for GA and a note on estimated attribution due to sampling. Legal: restrict exports in regulated regions; I'll produce the list.
Lina: UX: compact card with hover showing top-3 routes, annotation when data is estimated, and an export button (disabled with tooltip if blocked). Mock linked.
Ria: Agree on cuts for post-GA: per-model token breakdown, scripting hooks, real-time attribution. Keep those for v2.
Alex: Acceptance checklist (short): cost card + CSV; trace hooks API + smoke; weekly reconciliation job to flag >10% drift; canary runbook.
Sam: Perf: run small/med/large payloads (64/512/2048 tokens). Track obs.trace_hook.overhead_ms and request p95. Baseline before canary.
Jordan: Ops will add a canary dashboard and automated rollback playbook. I'll draft runbook by Wed.
Maya: I'll coordinate compliance flags and draft GA limitations for release notes.
Lina: I'll finalize mocks and microcopy calling out estimation and how to request full billing.
Ria: Owners: Alex (cost + export), Sam (trace hooks + perf), Jordan (canary + ops), Lina (UX), Maya (compliance). Delivery target: candidate to canary by Thu. Weekly check-ins Friday 09:00. Any objections?
All: :thumbsup:
Ria: Thanks — locking GA slice and updating roadmap now.
